issues.description: The solution implementation declares the toString method with return type Object (public Object toString()), but the problem statement and Java's contract expect toString() to return String. This causes a method return type mismatch and will prevent the solution from compiling and from correctly overriding Object.toString(), confusing students who rely on the reference solution or tests that expect a String return.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString method signature in the solution to public String toString() and ensure it returns a String. Update the implementation accordingly so it correctly overrides Object.toString() (remove the Object return type), e.g. public String toString() { return "Lecture{...}"; }.
